summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release titled "Monthly New Residential Construction, August 2022" (Release CB22-156), dated September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: Contains Table 1b (Not seasonally adjusted housing authorizations) and Table 3b (Not seasonally adjusted housing starts) for the United States, covering monthly data from August 2021 through August 2022. This document enables the evaluation of the task condition for August 2022 (the start of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 window) by providing the necessary month-over-month comparisons. August 2022 values are marked preliminary and subject to revision by later reports per task instructions; the document does not contain data for September 2022 through May 2025.
